scope: PLC/ABB missing physical_interface_kind must not abort LangChain diagnosis
root_cause: The deterministic planner selected check_network_path for simultaneous PLC/ABB failures even when helper events omitted physical_interface_kind, while the read-only tool safety validator correctly rejected non-confirmed ethernet events. The request therefore failed before the provider call.

verification.red_test_before_fix: DiagnosticToolError: 该工具只允许检查已配置的PLC或ABB网络接口

boundary: The actual provider call was verified through the loopback local-admin endpoint on the same restarted delivery process. The public domain health endpoint was verified separately; a second-PC authorized browser remains the user's acceptance environment.
